label: Legal services advertising
description: Layered on top of the generic set. Outcome prediction and specialist claims are the primary exposure for regulated legal practice.

rules.title: Predicting or promising a case outcome
rules.reason: No outcome can be promised in a legal matter. Every conduct regulator prohibits this.

rules.title: Unaccredited specialist or expert claims
rules.reason: "Specialist" and "expert" are restricted titles in many jurisdictions unless formally accredited.

rules.title: No-win-no-fee without qualification
rules.reason: Conditional fee claims must state that other costs may still apply.

rules.title: Regulatory authorisation statement
rules.reason: Regulated legal practices are generally required to state who authorises them.

rules.title: Pressuring a legal decision
rules.reason: Instructing a solicitor is not a decision that may be rushed by an advertising deadline.
